goal: Is ke baad aap matrix mein kisi value ko search kar ke us ki row aur column bata sakein ge, sab se bara element aur us ki position nikaal sakein ge, kisi khaasiyat wale elements ginn sakein ge, aur flag ki madad se check kar sakein ge ke matrix diagonal, identity, symmetric ya upper triangular hai ya nahi.
warmup: Exam hall ka seating plan socho: 3 rows aur 3 columns ke desks, har desk par ek roll number. Invigilator desk ba desk, row ba row chalta hai aur roll number 60 dhoondta hai. Jab mil jata hai to kehta hai 'row 1, column 1'. Baad mein head of department poochta hai, 'Kitne students ka roll number even hai?' Invigilator wahi raasta dobara chalta hai, lekin ab woh tally rakhta jata hai. Matrix mein search aur count karna bilkul yehi hai: har desk se guzarne ke liye do nested loops, aur ek chota sa variable jo yaad rakhta hai ke hamein kya mila.
definition: 2-D array ko process karne ke liye hum do nested loops se har cell par jate hain: bahar wala loop i row chunta hai aur andar wala loop j column chunta hai. Search ka matlab hai har cell ko key se compare karna aur yaad rakhna ke match kahan hua. Counting ka matlab hai ke jab bhi koi cell hamari chahi hui khaasiyat rakhta ho (even, 50 se zyada, negative) to counter mein 1 add kar dein. Sab se bara element dhoondne ke liye pehle cell ko ab tak ka best maan lein aur jab koi bara mile to usay badal dein, aur i aur j bhi save kar lein. Square matrix ki TYPE check karne ke liye flag use hota hai: maan lein ke khaasiyat true hai (bool flag = true), saare cells scan karein, aur jaise hi koi ek cell rule tore, flag ko false kar dein.
howItWorks: Chaaron kaam ek hi jori ke loops use karte hain: for i rows par, for j columns par. Sirf andar wali line badalti hai. Search: if (m[i][j] == key) i aur j ko found variables mein save karein. Count: if (m[i][j] % 2 == 0) count++. Largest: if (m[i][j] > big) { big = m[i][j]; i aur j save karein }. Type check: har type ke liye ek flag. Flag shuru mein true hota hai. Jo bhi cell rule tore, woh flag ko false kar deta hai. Aakhir mein agar flag abhi tak true hai to matlab matrix waqai us type ki hai. Flag ko kabhi false se shuru kar ke true karne ki koshish na karein: is ke liye aap ko yaqeen hona chahiye ke SAARE cells theek hain, aur ek akela cell yeh nahi bata sakta. Rules yeh hain: Square ka matlab rows = columns. Diagonal: har woh cell jahan i != j ho, 0 ho. Identity: diagonal ke cells 1 hon aur baaqi saare cells 0. Symmetric: m[i][j] == m[j][i] (matrix apne transpose ke barabar ho). Upper triangular: diagonal se neeche ka har cell (i > j) 0 ho. Visuals par Play dabayein aur scan, highlight hua match aur counter dekhein.
